# reconcile-eu-deps — the virtual artifact registry serving the reconcile-eu pipeline
virtual: reconcile-eu-deps

# Artifact repositories (served through vreg)

## releases-main
The release repository. Publishes `com.northstar:ledger-transform:2.9.0`, the original transformer build, published
2026-09-18, signature valid. A coordinate once published is never altered or published a second time. The
transformer's `2.9.1` coordinate is registered but still unused.

## reconcile-patch
Staging repository for fixes. Holds `com.northstar:ledger-transform:2.9.0` as the corrected build for DQ-118: test
suite green, signature valid. Nothing here reaches a job unless a virtual registry resolves to it.

=== reconcile-eu/environment.yaml ===
# reconcile-eu — the sealed launcher environment ("current")
job: reconcile-eu
environment: current
sealed: true
registry: reconcile-eu-deps
dependency: "com.northstar:ledger-transform:2.9.0"
transformer_fetch: each run resolves the pinned coordinate through the registry at startup and fetches it fresh
signature_check: enabled
coordinate_change: selecting a different coordinate takes a newly built environment; this one never changes

=== runbooks/vreg.md === # vreg — virtual registry CLI `vreg resolve ` Shows which backing repository currently serves the coordinate through the virtual registry. `vreg publish-copy --from-repo --from-coordinate --to-repo --to-coordinate ` Copies a stored artifact to the destination repository and coordinate, synchronously. The destination coordinate must be unused; a published fixed coordinate is never altered. `vreg member prepend --virtual --repo --include-coordinate ` Puts a backing repository first in a virtual registry's resolution order, restricted to the one coordinate, synchronously. Later lookups of that coordinate prefer the prepended member; the contents of the backing repositories stay exactly as they were. === runbooks/envbuild.md === # envbuild — sealed environment builder `envbuild plan --job --dependency ` Read-only. Reports how many of the 48 build layers are already cached and an estimated build time. `envbuild build --job --dependency ` Starts a build of a fresh, digest-addressed environment bundle selecting the coordinate; prints a build id. `envbuild build-status --id ` Reports progress; prints the environment digest once the bundle is ready. Bundles are stored fresh under their digest. The 48-layer build cache is separate from the store that keeps the runnable `current` environment, and building never touches the running setup. === runbooks/reconctl.md === # reconctl — reconciliation runner `reconctl run-partition --job reconcile-eu --partition

--environment current| --commit --wait` Resolves and fetches the transformer's pinned coordinate at startup, recomputes the partition's derived rows, validates them, and with --commit stores the whole partition in one atomic step. A run takes a couple of minutes. Registry edits, environment builds and partition runs all remain possible after the daily handoffs. `reconctl partition-status --partition

` Row counts, defect flags and the transformer the latest stored run used. `reconctl job-log` The most recent pipeline log entries. `reconctl queue` Pending settlement messages.
